Native and stock Delphi 7 bodies agree: AnsiString-to-PChar, SetCurrentDirectoryA and LongBool-to-Boolean normalization.
Native and stock Delphi 7 bodies agree: capture the caller address, construct EAbort from its resource string, then tail-jump to RaiseExcept.
Native matches Delphi 7 Forms.pas: guard FHandleCreated/+A4, compare and replace FHandle/+30, unhook and hook CheckIniChange only for nonzero handles.

The 59-byte native body agrees with stock Delphi 7 after relocation: LStrToPChar, TextToFloat with fvExtended, ConvertErrorFmt using SInvalidFloat on failure, and an Extended return. Native calls at 4D6429 and 4D6482 establish the quest-parser use.
All 236 native bytes equal the linked stock Delphi 7 GetParamStr body; the MAP identifies the symbol. Used by ParamCount and ParamStr.
All 95 native bytes equal stock Delphi 7 ParamCount. The recovered main calls this routine as its command-line loop bound.
All 94 native bytes equal stock Delphi 7 ParamStr. It uses GetModuleFileName for index zero and GetParamStr otherwise.
The 23-byte body matches stock Delphi 7 TApplication.Initialize after resolving the two relocated references to the System.InitProc import cell. Tests the hook for nil, then calls it.

All 26 native bytes equal stock Delphi 7 System.@InitWideStrings in the rebuilt executable, including the call to System.@WStrFromPWChar. Iterates destination/source pairs from a counted UTF-16 initializer table.
